mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, we are looking at overcast skies near Verona Area High School under the Full Moon. The overnight low will hit 46 degrees with no rain in the forecast. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

WisDOT is holding public meetings for the US 18/151 Corridor Study covering the stretch from Dodgeville to Fitchburg. They will share initial design concepts and gather public feedback, with both an in-person session at Mount Horeb High School on November 18 and a virtual meeting on November 19.
We have a full schedule ahead. Yoga at Insight Wellness is happening today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's, plus live music and pizza specials.

Looking at the weekly report, on October 25, officers were dispatched to Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they located a man who had been stationary for at least 20 minutes; he was subsequently arrested for O W I.
Today's flavor is the seasonal favorite, Pumpkin Pecan. Culver's is currently open until 10:00 PM, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
